title: Stage 13 pre-registration, addendum 4 (review: scoring vs generation, token roles, X3 lexical control, single model)
status_at_writing: X3 (para_gen / para_run) has no data. The P1 role breakdown below was computed (CPU preview) before this was written and is reported as exploratory.

X3.replaces: the X3 primary comparison of prereg.json (the partner B rule stays as a secondary comparison)
X3.primary: G'(l,pos) = cos(original, paraphrase) - cos(original, lexical neighbour D), where D is a different same-field paper (no shared surname) whose title word Jaccard with the original is >= the paraphrase's (closest above; else the highest available). 'Paper identity from layer l' requires G'(l) > 0 and G'(l) - G'(L4) > 0 (team-cluster intervals exclude 0), found on the tune split and confirmed on test.
X3.also: pairs where D's Jaccard is below the paraphrase's are reported separately (no matched neighbour available)

token_roles: Every patching / probe result on names (Stage 11 E1/E1t/E2, Stage 12 P1/P2/F2, X6/X7) is also reported by token role: first token of the name (initial or given name, predicted at ':'), first surname token, surname continuation; recovery ratios are not reported for roles whose true - false gap is below 0.05 (punctuation).
wording: Results are stated as the model's internal preference for the correct author tokens under teacher forcing (scored continuations), not as the process by which it generates authors.
